credits.title: CREDITS
credits.line_1: This game was developed by me, Demian Blogan.
credits.line_2: It was my first portfolio project in the world of IT.
credits.line_3: Version 1.0 began as a simple game that felt more like a homework assignment.
credits.line_4: Over time, through many updates, I improved it into Version 2.0,
credits.line_5: adding more mechanics, modes, polish, and content.
credits.line_6: What you see now is the fully finished game.
credits.contact: If you would like to contact me:

campaign_complete.line_1: Congratulations! I hope you enjoyed this game and had a great time with it.
campaign_complete.line_2: Keep playing games, discovering wonderful worlds, and completing great adventures.
campaign_complete.line_3: You have finished this journey, but your journey through games continues.
campaign_complete.postscript_1: P.S. Don't forget to try Horde Mode and Run Mode if you want to test your skills,
campaign_complete.postscript_2: or earn any achievements you haven't unlocked yet.

intro.run_objective: KEEP MOVING. ONE HIT ENDS THE RUN

tutorial.movement:
Press {bindings} to move your ship.
You can also use the Left Stick on your gamepad.
tutorial.fire: Hold {binding} or the Right Trigger on your gamepad to fire.
tutorial.asteroid: An asteroid has appeared ahead of you. Destroy it.
tutorial.fragments:
Large asteroids split into smaller fragments when destroyed.
Destroy both fragments.
tutorial.score:
Destroying asteroids and enemies awards points.
Your total score is displayed in the upper-left corner.
tutorial.armor:
Your armor is displayed in the lower-left corner.
If it reaches 0%, your ship will be destroyed.
tutorial.enemies:
Asteroids are not the only threat.
Enemy ships will hunt you and try to destroy your ship.
tutorial.shooter: An enemy gunship has appeared. Destroy it and evade its attacks.
tutorial.collision:
Be careful when touching asteroids or enemy ships.
Collisions damage both your ship and the enemy.
tutorial.shield_pickup:
Defeated enemies can drop useful bonuses.
Collect the shield bonus that has appeared.
tutorial.shield_info:
You collected a shield. Its meter is shown above your armor.
It absorbs damage, but its energy continuously drains.
tutorial.part_pickup:
Enemies sometimes drop special Parts that disappear quickly.
One has appeared in front of you. Collect it.
tutorial.part_info:
Parts are used to upgrade your ship between levels.
Parts collected during this level are shown in the lower-right corner.
tutorial.complete: Tutorial complete. Good luck on your adventure!
